# Nalix.AutoGenerated

> Roslyn incremental source generators for AOT-safe serialization, packet registry, and configuration.

**Nalix.AutoGenerated** is the compile-time engine of the Nalix ecosystem. It eliminates the need for runtime reflection or IL emission by generating efficient C# code during compilation. This ensures maximum performance and full compatibility with Native AOT and trimmed deployments.

## Generators

| Generator | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⚡ **SerializeFormatter** | Generates zero-allocation `IFormatter<T>` implementations. |
| 📋 **PacketRegistry** | Creates static opcode-to-type mapping and pooling logic. |
| 🔍 **PacketSchema** | Emits metadata for reflection-free packet introspection. |
| ⚙️ **Configuration** | Generates AOT-safe INI config binders. |

## Installation

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <ProjectReference Include="..\Nalix.AutoGenerated\Nalix.AutoGenerated.csproj" 
                    OutputItemType="Analyzer" 
                    ReferenceOutputAssembly="false" />
</ItemGroup>
```

> **Note:** Consuming projects reference this as an analyzer. It does not add any runtime DLL dependencies.

## Key Design Constraints

- **Incremental Performance:** Implements `IIncrementalGenerator` for fast IDE and build performance.
- **Zero Runtime Coupling:** Generates code using string-based type matching to avoid assembly dependencies.
- **AOT Compatible:** Produces code that is fully compatible with .NET 8/9+ Native AOT.

For details on source generation mechanics, see the [Auto-Generation Guide](https://ppn-system.me/api/AutoGen/index).
